text: This solution, Additional 1 Trillion Yuan Central Government Bonds for Disaster Relief and Flood Prevention (2023–2024) addresses natural catastrophe in People’s Republic of China between National People’s Congress Standing Committee (NPCSC), Ministry of Finance (MOF), National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), and Provincial and local governments. The program was implemented in 2023 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
